caption:
Keep one master resume and branch copies tailored per role.

JobRez is built on a clear premise: one master resume, branched for every role and matched to real postings. You maintain a single master resume, and branches are copies tailored per role. Each branch is scored against the posting in Job DNA.

Learn more at https://jobrez.com.
